title: Introduction to Inequalities
introduction: Develop secondary mathematical understanding through introduction to inequalities.
definition: An inequality compares expressions using <, >, ≤ or ≥. Adding or subtracting the same number on both sides preserves its direction. Multiplying or dividing both sides by a negative number reverses the inequality sign.

exercises.question: Is x=3 a solution of x<5? yes/no
Is x=5 a solution of x<5? yes/no
When dividing an inequality by a negative, does its sign reverse? yes/no
